desc: Implement a helper `feasible(L, s, numOps)` that computes total required flips as `sum((len_i + L - 1) // L - 1 for len_i in run_lengths)`.
Implement `minLength` using binary search on `L` from 1 to n, returning the smallest `L` that passes the feasibility test.
Ensure the run-length computation groups consecutive identical characters correctly.
Add a quick sanity test in comments or a small `if __name__ == "__main__"` block to validate the three example cases.
